import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Gender', loc='upper right')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Died', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Survival rate by embarkation port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
embark_survival['rate'] = embark_survival['sum'] / embark_survival['count']
embark_labels = {'S': 'Southampton', 'C': 'Cherbourg', 'Q': 'Queenstown'}
embark_survival.index = embark_survival.index.map(lambda x: embark_labels.get(x, x) if pd.notna(x) else 'Unknown')
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#95E1D3']
bars = ax3.bar(range(len(embark_survival)), embark_survival['rate'], color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Port of Embarkation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(embark_survival)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(embark_survival.index, rotation=15, ha='right')
ax3.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add value labels on bars
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{height:.2%}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Fare distribution by class with survival overlay
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    class_data = df[df['pclass'] == pclass]
    survived_fare = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 1]['fare'].dropna()
    ax4.scatter(survived_fare, [pclass]*len(survived_fare), alpha=0.5, s=30, 
               label=f'Class {pclass} - Survived', marker='o')

ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class (Survivors)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_yticks([1, 2, 3])
ax4.set_yticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])
ax4.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=8)
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax4.set_xlim(0, df['fare'].max() * 0.6)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
